decision.summary: The Fed held its policy rate at 1.75%. The vote was 10-0.

changes.quote: The information that has become available since the last meeting of the Committee indicates that the economy, bolstered by a marked swing in inventory investment, is expanding at a significant pace.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

changes.quote: Nonetheless, the degree of the strengthening in final demand over coming quarters, an essential element in sustained economic expansion, is still uncertain.
changes.explanation: Reworded from the previous statement: “The degree of any strength in business capital and household spending, however, is still uncertain.”

changes.quote: In these circumstances, although the stance of monetary policy is currently accommodative, the Committee believes that, for the foreseeable future, against the background of its long-run goals of price stability and sustainable economic growth and of the information currently available, the risks are balanced with respect to the prospects for both goals.
changes.explanation: Reworded from the previous statement: “Hence, the Committee continues to believe that, against the background of its long-run goals of price stability and sustainable economic growth and of the infor…”

changes.quote: The Committee decided to include in its announcements following its meetings the roll call of the vote on the federal funds rate target, including the preferred policy choice of any dissenters.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

changes.quote: This action accelerates the release of this information, currently available in the Minutes with a lag.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

changes.quote: To conform to this new practice, the Board of Governors also decided to report in the written announcement the roll call of any vote on the discount rate, also including the preferred policy choice of any dissenters.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

tone_quotes.quote: In these circumstances, although the stance of monetary policy is currently accommodative, the Committee believes that, for the foreseeable future, against the background of its long-run goals of price stability and sustainable economic growth and of the information currently available, the risks are balanced with respect to the prospects for both goals.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 14.21% APR costs about $59.21 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 5.33% and moved +1 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.87% would rise by about $2.00 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 5.7%, and employers added an average of -136k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 1.1% over the past year (February 2002); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.4%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 1.1% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -3 bp on the day.

whats_next: The dictionary tone reading is balanced.

citations.detail: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to keep its target for the federal funds rate unchanged at 1-3/4 percent.
